name: @anythingmcp/cli
description: Command-line client for AnythingMCP, the enterprise agent harness and MCP gateway: call MCP tools and fully manage your instance — connectors, MCP servers, users, roles and settings — from the terminal.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/cli.test.js
